entries.title: Revelation of John 20:1
segments: And I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, with the key of the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand.

entries.title: Revelation of John 20:2
segments: He gripped the dragon, that old serpent, who is the devil and Satan, and bound him for a thousand years,

entries.title: Revelation of John 20:3
segments: and flung him into the bottomless pit, and shut and sealed it over him, so that he should seduce the nations no more, until the thousand years were completed. After that it is necessary to loose him for a little while.

entries.title: Revelation of John 20:4
segments: And I saw thrones, and those who sat on them, and they were permitted to judge; and I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for the testimony of Jesus, and for the Word of God, those who did not worship the beast nor his image, and who did not receive his brand upon their brow, or hands. And they lived and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.

entries.title: Revelation of John 20:5
segments: The rest of the dead did not live until the thousand years were completed. This is the first resurrection.

entries.title: Revelation of John 20:6
segments: Blessed and holy is he who has a part in the first resurrection; on such the second death has no power, but they will be God's priests, and Christ's; and will reign with him for a thousand years.

entries.title: Revelation of John 20:7
segments: And when the thousand years have been completed, Satan will be loosed out of his prison,

entries.title: Revelation of John 20:8
segments: and will go forth to seduce the nations which are in the four quarters of the earth, Gog and Magog, to marshal them for war--their number is like the sands of the sea.

entries.title: Revelation of John 20:9
segments: And they went up over the broad earth, and surrounded the encampment of the saints, and the beloved city. Then fire fell from the sky and consumed them;

entries.title: Revelation of John 20:10
segments: and the devil who had been deceiving them was hurled into the lake of fire and brimstone, where lie also the beast and the false prophet. And they will be tortured day and night, forever and ever.

entries.title: Revelation of John 20:11
segments: And I saw a great white throne, and One who sat thereon; from his presence fled earth and sky, and no place was found for them.

entries.title: Revelation of John 20:12
segments: And I saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne; and books were opened, and another book--the Book of Life--was opened; and the dead were judged according to their deeds, by what was written in the books.

entries.title: Revelation of John 20:13
segments: The sea gave up the dead who were in it. Death and Hades gave up the dead who were in them.

entries.title: Revelation of John 20:14
segments: And all were judged according to their deeds. And Death and Hades were hurled into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.

entries.title: Revelation of John 20:15
segments: And if any one was found who was not written in the Book of Life, he was hurled into the lake of fire.
